The plate looks like a paper plate about 20 cm across, which sets the scale. It holds about 10 sausage slices, each roughly 4.5 cm across and 2 cm thick. A slice is about 30 g, so the pile is about 300 g. The slices are cut pieces, some of them halves, so I lowered that to about 270 g.
